name: Git Commit Helper
description: Generate conventional commit messages from diffs

skillFrontmatter.name: git-commit-helper
skillFrontmatter.description: Generate descriptive commit messages by analyzing git diffs. Use when the user asks for help writing commit messages or reviewing staged changes.

bodyTemplate:
# Git Commit Helper

When the user asks for a commit message:

1. Run `git status` and `git diff` (staged and unstaged)
2. Analyze the changes
3. Generate a commit message following these rules:

{{#if parameters.useConventional}}
- Use Conventional Commits: `type(scope): subject`
- Types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, test, chore
{{/if}}
- Keep subject under {{parameters.maxSubjectLength}} characters
{{#if parameters.includeBody}}
- Add a body explaining the why, not just the what
{{/if}}
- Focus on the "why" rather than the "what"
